primary_heading: К кончине бр. И. Ф. Гоцкого
persons_places: Иосиф Феодорович Гоцкий; П. Гоцкая; А. С. Макаренко; Николаев; Севастополь; Одесса; Харьков
content_summary: Primary obituary dossier combines the widow’s account and A. S. Makarenko’s independent letter. It traces conversion and baptism in 1900, persecution, Odessa presbyteral service, final illness and death on 25 April 1910. Two unnumbered plates preserve Gotskiy’s portrait and the funeral procession.
transcription_guard: Two biographical versions contain date and wording differences; retain each as a separate witness and cite the images for exact names and chronology.

persons_places: И. Гоцкий
content_summary: Poem attributed in print to I. Gotskiy meditates on rejection by the world, Christ’s betrayal and death, witness before rulers, heavenly peace and service to suffering people.
transcription_guard: The poem is interrupted in the PDF sequence by two inserted image plates; printed pagination controls the citation.

persons_places: Иса; Сархад; Индия; Баку; Бухара; Асхабад; Вильгельм Крейсман
content_summary: Translated testimony of a Muslim convert and preacher named Isa: Gospel contact in 1880, travel to India in 1889, preaching among Muslims, work in Baku with seventeen reported converts, and later activity in Bukhara and Ashgabat; the item reports revival in Russian Turkestan from summer 1908.
transcription_guard: The text is a translation from Sonnen-Aufgang no. 5, February 1908; distinguish the embedded testimony from editorial verification.

primary_heading: Бог мой ты, тебя я ищу
persons_places: Абрам Звенигородский; Киев; И. П. Кушнеров
content_summary: Autobiographical letter by the sixty-two-year-old Jewish blacksmith Abram Zvenigorodskiy recounts a long religious search, contact with Kushnerov in Kyiv and a request for correspondence and contacts with believers across Russia.
transcription_guard: Do not merge this person with unrelated genealogy records; identity is supported only by the primary letter.

persons_places: anonymous narrator
content_summary: Personal conversion and doctrinal meditation contrasts inherited religiosity with direct reading of Scripture and presents Christ as teacher, Savior and the only name of salvation.
transcription_guard: No author is printed in the visible article; do not attribute it to Prokhanov or another editor.

persons_places: Дмитрий Арсенкин
content_summary: Devotional exposition of the unsearchable riches of Christ, eternal life, the new covenant and the call to receive and follow Christ; signed Dmitriy Arsenkin.
transcription_guard: Modern summary only; preserve old orthography and biblical citation forms in direct quotation.

primary_heading: К кончине брата Иосифа Феодоровича Гоцкого. Из письма бр. И. М. Тимохина
persons_places: И. М. Тимохин; И. Ф. Гоцкий; Одесса; Харьков
content_summary: Timokhin’s independent memoir continues the Gotskiy dossier: he came to Odessa on 4 March 1910 at Gotskiy’s invitation, describes his concern for unity and service, the 20 March departure for Kharkov, the urgent telegram of 3 April, their 6-14 April conversations and Gotskiy’s expectation of death.
transcription_guard: Keep Timokhin’s dates separate from the June obituary accounts; reconcile only after a dedicated chronology table.

persons_places: Д. С. Чехмарев; Казань; последователи Кондрата Малеванного; Ф. М. Зуйков
content_summary: Autobiographical conversion letter describes the writer’s father being confined in the Kazan psychiatric hospital for Bible teaching, contacts with followers of Kondrat Malevanniy, the arrival of F. M. Zuykov in Kazan in 1909 and the writer’s conversion before military service.
transcription_guard: The psychiatric and legal claims are personal testimony; do not generalize them without archival corroboration.

persons_places: М. Н. Си—ов; Донская область
content_summary: Mission report from the Don region describes crowd harassment, threats, detention, seizure of documents and forced departure of visiting believers.
transcription_guard: The signature is abbreviated in print; never expand the surname beyond М. Н. Си—ов without a second source.

primary_heading: Письмо о положении общин в Новгородской губернии
persons_places: Новгородский и Крестецкий уезды; латышские лютеране; баптисты
content_summary: Unsigned report estimates about five hundred Baptists in the Novgorod and Kresttsy districts, notes only one preacher, a youth union for visits and correspondence, and an acute need for Russian-language evangelism.
transcription_guard: The numerical estimate is the correspondent’s claim; preserve the anonymous signature «Верующий».

primary_heading: Как началось дело Божие в М. Б. Токмак, Таврическ. губ.
persons_places: Василий К. Ермоленко; Большой Токмак; С. П. Жук; Правосверов; Балихин; Кушнеров
content_summary: Local origin narrative dates the beginning of evangelical work in Bolshoy Tokmak to December 1906 and names itinerant workers and the first peasant household involved.
transcription_guard: Several surnames require diplomatic spelling from the page before authority-file merging.

persons_places: Стефан Трофимович Дешко; Раевка; Черниговская губерния
content_summary: Spiritual autobiography dated 21 July 1908 describes Bible reading, personal conversion and work among children and youth.
transcription_guard: The printed locality/volost spelling is difficult; retain the scan as authority and avoid silent normalization.

persons_places: Ф. П. Балихин; Астрахань; Бердянск; Симферополь; Севастополь; Одесса; Николаев; Харьков; Полтава; Александровск; Екатеринослав; Нижнеднепровск; Ростов-на-Дону; Сибирь; Самара; Балашов; Борисоглебск
content_summary: Quantified missionary itinerary reports seven months away from home, dozens of meetings and sermons across southern Russia, the Volga and Siberia, including thirteen baptisms in Nikolaev, fourteen in Nizhnedneprovsk, forty-eight Siberian meetings and six theater meetings in Borisoglebsk.
transcription_guard: Counts are the author’s own annual report; retain exact locality spellings and do not aggregate with other years.

persons_places: Ф. Н. Б.; Довар; Ставропольская губерния
content_summary: Short testimony concerns prayer and the recovery of a sick child.
transcription_guard: The correspondent uses initials only; no identity expansion.

persons_places: Кондрат Григорьевич Гуразда; Федоровка; Августиновка
content_summary: Report states that a fifteen-member church was baptized on 18 May and documents a burial conflict after a priest initially refused cemetery burial of a six-year-old child of believers.
transcription_guard: Use neutral wording; the account is a partisan primary testimony and the locality spellings require visual citation.

persons_places: И. П. Кушнеров; Аристарх Филиппович Трипольский; Ефим Резник; Трофим Антонович Яценко; Изюм; Киевская губерния
content_summary: Kushnerov documents two legal cases: prolonged solitary detention of A. F. Tripolskiy after a blasphemy accusation linked to a Russian-language funeral psalm, and conviction/detention of T. A. Yatsenko for not removing his hat at a prayer service. Dated 14 June 1910.
transcription_guard: Legal details are reported by Kushnerov; court files remain the next corroboration layer.

primary_heading: Краткий обзор деятельности С.П.Б. Д.К.Е.Х. за три года его существования
persons_places: Санкт-Петербургский девичий кружок евангельских христиан; Санкт-Петербург
content_summary: Three-year report of the St Petersburg girls’ circle, founded 6 January 1907 with sixteen members: women’s evangelistic meetings, choir and Sunday-school work, handicraft sales for mission, poor relief, children’s celebrations, summer shelter, literature distribution and sick visiting. Financial report for 1907-1909 gives income 1,135 rubles 21 kopecks, expenses 985 rubles 35 kopecks and balance 149 rubles 86 kopecks.
transcription_guard: The acronym is interpreted from the article; preserve the original abbreviation alongside the expanded form in publication.

primary_heading: Письмо от И. П. Кушнерова. Забытая заповедь Господа Иисуса
persons_places: И. П. Кушнеров; Россия; преследуемые и заключенные верующие
content_summary: Kushnerov argues that defense of persecuted believers requires visits, legal aid and material support, not prayer alone. He criticizes the absence of a defined common fund and calls for at least an annual collection for prisoners, legal defense and their families.
transcription_guard: Institutional criticism is the author’s position; quote exact formulations only from the primary image.

primary_heading: Смерть от голода в культурной и христианской стране
persons_places: Александровск; Екатеринославская губерния; врач Поляков; Задунайский
content_summary: Eyewitness account dated 20 July 1910 describes a starving woman with an infant collapsing in public, refusal of aid by bystanders and later transport to a municipal hospital, using the case as a Christian appeal against indifference.
transcription_guard: The report is moral advocacy and an eyewitness claim; do not infer the woman’s later fate.

persons_places: И. Долинов-Шпиндовский; И. Д. Рабинович; Кишинев; еврейская миссия
content_summary: Essay argues for permanent local evangelistic centers among Jewish communities rather than rare missionary visits and pamphlet distribution; it recalls I. D. Rabinovich and the former New Testament Israelite temple in Kishinev.
transcription_guard: Author surname and historical references should be cited diplomatically; do not turn the essay’s mission strategy into an objective demographic claim.

persons_places: А. Р. М.; генерал-майор Думбадзе; Ялта; Г. П. и Л. П. Костюковы; Р. А. Малей; Ф. И. Жимико; П. И. и У. К. Давыдовы
content_summary: First-person account describes six believers ordered by General-Major Dumbadze to leave Yalta within three days as politically unreliable, despite the author’s assertion that the conflict was religious rather than political.
transcription_guard: Names are read from a difficult list and require page-image citation; the political/religious interpretation is the author’s claim.

primary_heading: Из уст детей Ты устроил хвалу
persons_places: хутор Кольцовка; пять братьев; сестра-старушка; восемь девочек 8-13 лет; два мальчика
content_summary: Extended narrative of a 7 June 1910 children’s mission trip to the remote farm Koltsovka: two horse wagons carried adult workers and ten schoolchildren, hymns drew villagers, children participated in an open-air evangelistic meeting, and the visit ended with reported prayer, tears and requests for further teaching.
transcription_guard: The piece is literary reportage with anonymous initials for participants; do not invent identities or exact attendance beyond the text.

persons_places: Е. Сологуб; Ревель; А. А. Рейлор/Рейфер (неуверенное чтение); Я. И. Сиваков; д-р М. М. Никулина
content_summary: Letter sketches the small Russian evangelical community in Revel, the visit of a Petersburg brother, lack of preachers and meeting space, the opening of meetings in sister Gakke’s home and later reconciliation and support associated with Ya. I. Sivakov.
transcription_guard: One visitor surname is palaeographically uncertain; retain the ambiguous printed form until a second witness is found.

persons_places: Михаил Кривенко; Герюсовка; Елисаветпольская губерния; Иван Степанович Культенко; П. Дацко; Афанасий Адрианович Хмельницкий; Белгород
content_summary: News page records the death of Mikhail Krivenko from cholera on 20 July 1910 after five years of suffering for the faith, leaving seven children, and asks readers to place at least two orphans. It also advertises evangelical tracts and one-month regent/violin training in Belgorod.
transcription_guard: The orphan appeal is time-specific historical evidence; do not present the address as current.

persons_places: И. К. Вязовский
content_summary: Short review praises a booklet arguing for the historical and theological primacy of Sunday observance over Sabbath observance.
transcription_guard: This is a review of another publication, not an original doctrinal treatise in the issue.
